The Wirtschaftliche Aufbau-Vereinigung ( transl. Economic Reconstruction Organization ) was a German-Russian conspiratorial group which was founded in Munich in 1920 and ceased to exist in 1924. Dedicated to the partnership of anti- Bolshevik völkisch Germans and Russian émigrés , the organization aimed to overthrow the Soviet Union and the Weimar Republic . The Aufbau-Vereinigung was led by Max Erwin von Scheubner-Richter , Vasily Biskupsky , and Alfred Rosenberg . Its membership and ideology overlapped with the early Nazi party; the degree to which the organization influenced later Nazi ideology is debated. [ 1 ] [ 2 ] [ 3 ] [ 4 ]
